notes.title: Update from the Team
notes.content:
Hello there folks,

I just wanted to let everyone know that I've been in contact with our dev team, the game is still under development despite the lack of updates I've been able to share with you. Unfortunately, due to some real life health concerns, development of The Tau Experiment has slowed down. And this has sadly also impacted the devs time on discord to interact with you, the community.

This has also meant that the release date has also been pushed back, and that a new date will be published as development picks up again. Of course, there will still be an Early Access period, but I can only tell you that information regarding this will come at a later date.


I'm still about on discord though, and TAU CORP is always watching... so be careful!



Heyallo
Community Manager, Mistflux Games.


For any Press Inquiries, please contact:
press@mistflux.co.uk

notes.title: Coming soon, the prologue (and 0.7)
notes.content:
Hey there everyone!

I just wanted to catch you up on what the dev team has been working hard at, the prologue! That's right folks, coming very soon is the first release in our 0.7 branch. Everyone here at Mistflux is pretty excited and this will first be released to our testers hopefully by the end of the next week, and as an added bonus, I've been informed there may be a public beta test as well. 

Does this interest you? If you answered yes, please come visit our discord server where more information will be made available as we get closer to the 0.7 release.

You can find our discord via the steam store page, or for your convenience, right here! 
https://discord.mistflux.co.uk/


Keep Calm, Stay Vigilant. You never know when or where Tau Corp is watching...



Heyallo
Community Manager, Mistflux Games.

notes.title: An update to our community
notes.content:
Hey all!

We want to thank you for your continued support throughout the development of The Tau Experiment!

We also want you all to know that we have had a few setbacks in the development process, but we're looking upon the here and now as a fresh start and hopefully a brighter future for the game.

Despite the lack of updates recently, we are still committed and working tirelessly on a game that will have fantastic game play and one that we hope you all will enjoy!

Hope to see you in future updates!
